items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Right over there. Sheik. We just saw Sheik walking over there by the corner here a minute ago. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. If he knew you was coming there, he already came with you.
